name: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest

angles.text: Lord Falconcrest and his Syndicate operatives threaten Stromgarde's remnants. This bounty matters to the effort to reclaim the highlands.
As a human, you face a personal fight. Bringing down the Syndicate's traitorous human nobles helps avenge your fallen kingdom.

faq.answer: Lord Falconcrest is a noble who commands the Syndicate's operations in the Arathi Highlands. He organizes their bid to seize the broken kingdom of Stromgarde, making him a chief target of the local human militia.
Otto is Lord Falconcrest's deadly personal bodyguard. A ferocious combatant rather than a strategist, he has slain dozens of Stromgarde defenders in the highlands.

The Stromgarde Militia seeks to cripple the Syndicate's leadership in the Arathi Highlands. Falconcrest's death would disrupt their regional command, while Otto's death would remove a lethal threat who has killed many Alliance fighters.
faq.q: Why has the Stromgarde Militia placed a bounty on them?

faq.answer: Captain Nials, an officer of the Stromgarde Militia at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands, collects the bounties for Lord Falconcrest and Otto.
faq.q: Who offers the reward for Otto and Falconcrest?

faq.answer: The Syndicate is made up of fallen Alteraci nobles and rogue elements seeking land and riches amid northern Lordaeron's collapse. From the Arathi Highlands, they have moved into Stromgarde's ruins to wrest control from its surviving defenders.
faq.q: What is the Syndicate doing in the Arathi Highlands?

faq.answer: Bring the severed heads of Lord Falconcrest and Otto directly to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe as proof of their deaths.
faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?

sections.body: From Refuge Pointe, Stromgarde's defenders seek to break the Syndicate's hold over their ancestral lands. The militia has placed a bounty on Lord Falconcrest and Otto, his bodyguard. Bring both targets' heads to Captain Nials to claim the reward.
sections.title: A Desperate Bounty

sections.body: Lord Falconcrest directs the Syndicate's push into the Arathi Highlands. His death would disrupt the criminal network's work in the region. Otto is a brutally effective bodyguard. His blades have killed dozens of Stromgarde's remaining militia soldiers.
sections.title: Commander and Enforcer

summary: In the Arathi Highlands, the Stromgarde Militia has marked Lord Falconcrest and Otto for death. Falconcrest leads the local Syndicate forces, and Otto guards him with deadly skill. Their deaths would weaken the Syndicate's hold in the region. Proof must reach Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
attribution: In-game quest text: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest
